# setup

```{r, message=FALSE}
# --- Load libraries and custom functions ---
library(Seurat)
```

Generate MiXCR sample sheets from Seurat cell barcodes.

```{r}
# --- Define output directory for MiXCR sample sheets ---
output_dir <- file.path("/mnt/petasan_immuno/raw_data/itag/collabs/sturcotte/scSeq/deconv/seurat", pt, "10x_sample_sheets")
dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE)
# --- Extract cell barcodes and sample identifiers ---
sample_sheet_data <- data.frame(
  cell_name = colnames(obj),
  sample_id = as.character(obj$sample_id),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
# --- Generate a 10x sample sheet for each experimental condition ---
for (current_sample in sort(unique(sample_sheet_data$sample_id))) {
  current_cells <- sample_sheet_data$cell_name[
    sample_sheet_data$sample_id == current_sample
  ]
  barcodes <- sub(
    pattern = paste0("^", current_sample, "_"),
    replacement = "",
    x = current_cells
  )
  barcodes <- sub(
    pattern = "-[0-9]+$",
    replacement = "",
    x = barcodes
  )
  sample_sheet <- data.frame(
    Sample = rep(current_sample, length(barcodes)),
    tagPattern = rep("", length(barcodes)),
    `CELL*` = barcodes,
    check.names = FALSE,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  sample_output_dir <- file.path(output_dir, current_sample)
  dir.create(sample_output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  output_file <- file.path(
    sample_output_dir,
    "10x-sample-sheet.tsv"
  )
  write.table(
    sample_sheet,
    file = output_file,
    sep = "\t",
    quote = FALSE,
    row.names = FALSE,
    col.names = TRUE,
    na = ""
  )
  message(
    "Generated: ",
    output_file,
    " | Cells: ",
    nrow(sample_sheet)
  )
}
```
